display.title: Episode 548: Reb Boruch and the Alter Rebbe's Blessing, Chapter 1 (Parshas Chayei Sarah)
display.summary_short: Living with the weekly parsha and the kindness of Rivkah at the well, Shema with a Brooklyn class, and the start of a story about an honest Jew framed by a jealous enemy.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the Sunday that began the week of Parshas Chayei Sarah 5753. Uncle Yossi explains how the parsha is divided into seven daily portions, so we 'live with the times' as the Alter Rebbe taught, learning each day's section. From this week's parsha he draws a lesson in kindness: Eliezer looked for a wife for Yitzchak who would offer water not only to him but to his camels too, giving more than she was asked. After the Hakochainik march, a class from a Brooklyn girls' school leads the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. Story time begins a new tale: Reb Boruch, a kind and honest Jew, supervises a government lumberyard in a Russian town. Alex, a cruel man fired from the same yard, is consumed by jealousy and hides twenty stolen railroad logs in Reb Boruch's barn, then reports him. Reb Boruch is summoned to the minister's office on Tuesday morning. He goes to the Alter Rebbe, who smiles and tells him to come back next Sunday, after the appointment. Trusting the tzaddik, Reb Boruch decides not to go. The outcome is promised for next week.
display.lesson: Be kind to others and give even more than they ask; and trust a tzaddik's guidance even when it is hard to understand.
